description: Open a project file (.prproj) and make it the active project, with Premiere Pro's convert, locate-file and warning dialogs turned off unless showDialogs is true. Projects already open stay open

addToRecent.description: Add the project to File > Open Recent. Default true

showDialogs.description: Let Premiere Pro show its convert, locate-file and warning dialogs (they wait for the user). Default false

name: open_project
title: Open Project
